purpose: Authorize one CPU-only contract smoke that determines whether the existing audited Cano perception mesh can produce deterministic topology-consistent 16x720 idealized LiDAR observations without Isaac.

approval.scope: Exactly one execution of the frozen seed-0 Cano CPU raycast diagnostic contract: 1 existing world, 24 fixed poses, two independent 16x720 raycast passes, analytic control, prior-reference regression and complete visual evidence; zero formal dataset, training, model, Isaac, Gazebo, topology or M-TARE work.
approval.confirmation_reference: 用户在收到完整输入、方法、样本数、成本、验收与停止边界后明确回复：继续做啊为啥这么容易停

source.topology_provenance: procedural-subt-gen refactor@b6c77621187404b4dfab1249c7a1b40f63ad9ab3 through the project read-only adapter
source.known_geometry_risk: The native Poisson mesh is one component but is not edge-manifold, watertight or orientable and is self-intersecting. Those defects fail dynamic navigation qualification and must remain visible in the LiDAR contract report.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research audit only. Upstream lacks a verified license text at the pinned commit, so no third-party source redistribution or modified-source publication is authorized.

sampling.selection_rule: Reuse the exact deterministic 24-pose manifest already derived from the frozen Cano graph/splines: two interior poses per tunnel, two views per degree-3 junction and two inward offsets per terminal. No pose is selected from LiDAR quality.
sampling.pose_rule: Reuse the exact deterministic 24-pose manifest already derived from the frozen Cano graph/splines: two interior poses per tunnel, two views per degree-3 junction and two inward offsets per terminal. No pose is selected from LiDAR quality.
sampling.sensor_contract: Open3D 0.19.0 CPU first-return raycasting on the exact frozen 16x720 VLP16-like grid, with range_m and valid_mask in the robot frame, near/far 0.3/50 m, no noise and no retry or scan-quality selection.

sensor_parameters.representation: 16x720 range_m plus valid_mask in robot frame
sensor_parameters.frame: right-handed robot frame, x forward, y left, z up; world is metres and Z-up

sampling.label_contract: For every pose, intersect every frozen Cano tunnel spline with a 5 m 3-D sphere around the axis anchor, deduplicate headings within 8 degrees, rotate headings into robot frame and form a 720-bin circular Gaussian target with sigma 3 degrees. Labels are topology oracle targets and are never model input.
sampling.causality: The student-side artifact contains only one local idealized scan and pose-relative ray metadata. Full graph/splines are teacher/provenance only. No future trajectory or M-TARE benchmark observation is used.

evidence.machine_metrics: Preserve source/tool/environment hashes; analytic-ray control; exact pose/role/ray counts; shape, dtype, finite, near/far, valid-ratio, minimum-clearance, branch-line-of-sight, duplicate-run determinism and prior-reference regression metrics for every pose.
evidence.complete_visual_review: Produce one full-world pose map and one fixed-scale contact sheet containing all 24 range images with role, sample ID, valid ratio and topology-label headings. No best-case selection. Each figure has matching JSON provenance and states that it cannot prove Gazebo/real sensor parity.
evidence.failure_policy: Stop on any source/hash/schema mismatch, analytic-ray error, pose-count drift, non-finite valid range, near/far violation, deterministic replay mismatch, prior-reference drift, failed clearance/branch LOS, missing full visualization or evidence. Do not repair the mesh, change poses, lower thresholds, change sensor, generate another world or train.

estimated_cost.compute: After approval only: one CPU process in the frozen E1 environment, approximately 552,960 world rays for two deterministic passes plus small analytic controls; no Docker, GPU, Isaac, Gazebo or training.
